patch_list: Signs in through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore to be installed.
Allows screenshots and screen recording on every screen.
Unlocks all chapters, practice sets, flashcards, hardest questions, mock tests and PYQ Marked NCERT questions.
